cards.title: Here's what happened (explain it like I'm 12)
cards.text:
- Plain English: A mortgage rate is the price of borrowing money to buy a home. When it goes up, the exact same house costs more every month.
- 30-year fixed mortgage rate: over the past month it is down 0.29 percentage points (from 7.40% on Oct 8, 2026).
- [HEADLINE 1] Show the headline: “Mortgage Rates Ease in Weekly Survey Ahead of JOLTS | Today, November 3, 2026” (The Mortgage Reports). It is a news report, so check any number in it before you say it.
- [HEADLINE 2] Show the headline: “Post-election bond market calm and easing Treasury yields pull borrowing costs to their lowest level in a month” (Mortgage Professional America). It is a news report, so check any number in it before you say it.

cards.title: What it means for you: Mortgage
cards.text:
- The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 7.11% as of Nov 12, 2026.
- Worked example: a 30-year loan for 80% of the median home price ($393,300 in Q3 2026, so a $314,640 loan) costs about $2,117 a month in principal and interest at 7.11%. That is about $185 a month more than at the rate a year ago (6.22%).
- If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage, your payment does not change. This matters if you are buying, refinancing or have an adjustable rate.

cards.title: What it means for you: Job
cards.text:
- The unemployment rate was 4.1% as of October 2026.
- That is down 0.3 percentage points from September 2025, when it was 4.4% (the closest reading to a year earlier; October 2025 was never published).
- Explain what this means for someone job-hunting or asking for a raise: a tighter market gives workers more leverage, a looser one gives employers more.

cards.title: What it means for you: Mortgage
cards.text:
- The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 7.11% as of Nov 12, 2026.
- Worked example: a 30-year loan for 80% of the median home price ($393,300 in Q3 2026, so a $314,640 loan) costs about $2,117 a month in principal and interest at 7.11%. That is about $185 a month more than at the rate a year ago (6.22%).
- If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage, your payment does not change. This matters if you are buying, refinancing or have an adjustable rate.

cards.title: What it means for you: Job
cards.text:
- The unemployment rate was 4.1% as of October 2026.
- That is down 0.3 percentage points from September 2025, when it was 4.4% (the closest reading to a year earlier; October 2025 was never published).
- Explain what this means for someone job-hunting or asking for a raise: a tighter market gives workers more leverage, a looser one gives employers more.
